Initializes selected gametype/map/update/player-count and local ZM models, builds party/map/setup/start/header/preview/lab controls. Map selection requires host and no countdown; offline-ZM-private opens a different chooser, otherwise generic map/game chooser. Host Start launches only if every client owns DLC, else opens maps-not-enabled popup; both action branches return true while label callbacks return false. CustomGames action chooses ZM custom mutation or non-ZM custom-games overlay. State family preserves ZM live/LAN/host/offline predicates, WZ IsWarzone, and PC variant. Model/session/focus callbacks refresh state/labels/descriptions/draft models; the repeated ShowDirectorCustom elseif is retained literally. LobbyNav focus changes prioritize ZM custom host tutorial, then custom host StartButton, then ZM custom nonhost home. Close registration/postload precede platform-specific preGameType and default-focus update. Every nested function/return/guard remains below; no ZM-only gameplay or real launch is claimed.
